During the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Vich]] formed a '''personal army''' comprised of [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] warriors. During the war, Vich attempted to use his army to stage a [[Darth Vich's insurrection|coup]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] ruling [[Dark Council]] but ultimately failed. The surviving Rattataki were either [[Death/Legends|killed]] or [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]].
